blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Shapley-value-based explanations are widely used for feature attribution in machine learning. However, in computer vision, a feature may reduce the target-class score when added to the complete genuine image, even when the predicted label remains unchanged. We formalize such features as contextual distractors and investigate their attributions under semivalues and the least core. Under a weak average marginal monotonicity assumption, we derive quantitative semivalue--least-core gap bounds and sufficient conditions based on the probability of sampling smaller contexts. We further show that shifting semivalue weights toward larger contexts decreases the signed gap. Finally, controlled image-classification experiments and evaluations on Salient ImageNet provide strong empirical support for our theoretical findings.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A central goal in explainable AI is to understand why a classifier makes a particular decision. For a fixed input, this often amounts to identifying a subset of features that best accounts for the prediction. In image classification, for instance, one may seek a small subset of pixels, patches, or segments whose presence suffices to preserve the predicted label under masking. The size constraint is important: without it, the full image would often be a trivial but uninformative explanation. This problem becomes especially challenging in computer vision, where explanations must scale to high-dimensional inputs and, at the same time, remain meaningful.
blocks.zh: 解释性大赦国际的一个中心目标是了解为什么一个分类员作出具体的决定。 就固定输入而言,这通常相当于确定一个能最好地说明预测的特征子集。 例如,在图像分类中,人们可能寻求一个小子集的像素,补丁,或片段,其存在足以在遮罩下保存所预测的标签. 尺寸限制很重要:没有这种限制,完整的图像往往只是一个微不足道但无参考性的解释. 这个问题在计算机视觉中变得特别具有挑战性,在计算机视觉中,解释必须扩大到高维度输入,同时仍然有意义。

blocks.en: Game-theoretic methods have proved useful in this setting because they provide principled ways to reason about feature importance. In particular, the Shapley value [ 40 ] has become a standard attribution mechanism, due to its simplicity and its appealing axiomatic properties. However, two difficulties remain. The first, which is widely recognized, is computational: exact Shapley values require evaluating the characteristic function on all subsets of the N N players. As a result, much of the literature has focused on approximation methods, especially sampling-based schemes [ 45 , 34 , 18 , 1 , 25 ] , as well as more efficient computation under structural assumptions on the characteristic function [ 15 , 8 ] . These guarantees have been further improved under assumptions such as submodularity [ 3 , 4 ] and supermodularity [ 31 ] . However, such assumptions are unlikely to hold in natural settings, especially in computer vision, so these positive guarantees generally do not extend to the regimes of interest.
blocks.zh: 事实证明,游戏理论方法在这种背景下是有用的,因为它们提供了说明特征重要性的原则性方法。 特别是"Shapley"值[40]已经成为一个标准的归属机制,因为它简洁而具有吸引力的逻辑属性. 然而,仍然存在两个困难。 被广泛承认的第一种是计算:准确的Shapley值需要评价N玩家所有子集的特征函数. 因此,许多文献都侧重于近似方法,特别是基于抽样的计划[45,34,18,1,25],以及在特征函数的结构假设下更有效率的计算[15,8]. 这些担保在亚模 [3, 4] 和超模 [31] 等假设下得到了进一步的改进. 然而,在自然环境下,特别是在计算机视觉中,这种假设不太可能存在,因此,这些积极保证一般不会延伸到利益制度。

blocks.en:
While the computational challenge of Shapley values is well understood, a second and more conceptual issue that is less studied, is the effect of averaging-based attributions in the presence of spurious contextual cues. In particular, a group of features may appear beneficial on average, even though it is harmful precisely in the contexts that are most informative for the prediction. In computer vision, for example, background patches, textures, or correlated artifacts can bias the classifier toward a label without capturing the actual object of interest. Furthermore, the characteristic function that is induced from such effects is unlikely to satisfy regularities such as submodularity/supermodularity.
See Figure 1 for an illustration of this effect.
blocks.zh:
虽然Shapley值的计算挑战是可以理解的,但第二个和更多的概念性问题较少研究,是在存在虚假背景提示的情况下基于平均的归属的影响. 特别是,一组特征在一般看来可能是有益的,尽管在对预测最有信息性的背景中,这恰恰是有害的。 例如,在计算机视觉中,背景补丁、纹理或相关文物可以将分类器偏向标签,而不捕捉实际感兴趣的对象。 此外,这种效应所引发的特征功能不大可能满足亚模/超模等规律性.
这方面的说明见图一。

blocks.en:
This phenomenon is closely related to several well-known shortcut examples in computer vision. In [ 38 ] , background snow can spuriously drive a wolf-vs-husky classifier. In [ 5 ] , animal classifiers are shown to rely on contextual cues such as water rather than the animal itself. The Waterbirds benchmark in [ 32 ] makes this explicit by contrasting waterbird/landbird identity with background, so that background can dominate the prediction. Similarly, [ 43 ] documents situations in which a correlated context, such as the presence of a person together with a skateboard, can dominate the classifier’s reasoning. In [ 29 ] , explanation maps reveal that models sometimes rely on artifacts such as source tags rather than the object.
These examples suggest that a feature group can look useful on average, yet still be harmful in the important contexts one actually cares about. This is precisely the type of behavior that Shapley values may overlook through contextual averaging. This perspective motivates moving beyond purely averaging-based attributions toward stability-based notions such as the least-core [ 35 ] , which focus on the coalitions that matter most rather than averaging over all contexts, which is precisely the direction we pursue in this work.
blocks.zh:
这一现象与计算机视觉中几个众所周知的捷径例子密切相关. 在 [38] 中,背景雪可以虚假地驱动狼-vs-husky分类器. 在[5]中,动物分类者被显示依赖于水等上下文提示而不是动物本身. [32]中的"水鸟"基准通过将水鸟/地鸟的特性与背景对比来说明这一点,这样背景就可以主导预测. 同样,[43] 记录了一种相关情况,例如一个人与滑板一起出现,可以支配分类者的推理。 在[29]中,解释地图揭示出模型有时依赖于出源标记等文物而非物体.
这些例子表明,一个专题小组一般看起来有用,但在人们实际关心的重要情况下仍然有害。 这恰恰是Shapley值可能通过上下文平均忽略的行为类型。 这种观点促使人们超越纯粹基于平均的归属,转向基于稳定的概念,如最不核心[35],这些概念侧重于最重要的联盟,而不是在所有情况下平均的联盟,这正是我们在这项工作中追求的方向。

Our work is related to three strands of literature. First, Shapley-value-based explanations and, more broadly, semivalue methods such as Data Shapley, Beta Shapley, Data Banzhaf, and weighted Banzhaf have become standard tools for attribution in machine learning, including in computer vision through Shapley estimators tailored to vision transformers [ 34 , 47 , 28 , 48 , 12 ] .
Unlike this line of work, which remains averaging-based, we compare semivalue methods against a stable attribution method, which is the least-core.

Second, a growing literature studies limitations of Shapley-style explanations, including their dependence on the choice of value function, baseline values, occlusion strategy, or feature distribution, and the possibility of misleading feature-importance scores [ 47 , 24 , 1 , 23 , 37 , 6 , 7 ] .
Our work complements these critiques by identifying a specific mechanism behind such failures in vision-like settings, namely the presence of contextual distractors.

我们的工作补充了这些批评,找出了类似愿景环境中这种失败背后的一个具体机制,即存在背景分心器。

blocks.en: Third, our work is related to the literature on shortcut learning, spurious correlations, and explanation-based bias detection in classifiers [ 2 ] . This work documents that models can rely on spurious cues and studies whether post hoc explanations can reveal such behavior. Our contribution is about formalizing this phenomenon through coalitional games and the notion of a contextual distractor. Furthermore, we show both theoretically and empirically when stability-based explanations can differ sharply from averaging-based ones.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和讨论

blocks.en:
Our results highlight the least core as a complementary attribution
method, particularly for computer vision, where a large
semivalue–least-core gap may indicate shortcut features or
contextual distractors. Its main limitation is computational:
Eqn. ( 4 ) involves exponentially many coalition
constraints. Although the LP can be solved in polynomial time
given an efficient separation oracle via the ellipsoid method [ 20 , 14 ] , such oracles
may be difficult to obtain in practice. Developing scalable
least-core algorithms, through application-specific structure
or heuristic separation oracles, remains an important direction
for future work.

We conclude with the perspective of Hart and Mas-Colell [ 21 ] , who emphasize the value of studying
different cooperative solution concepts: A simpler solution may be easier to study and apply, which
increases its usefulness. However, it is important to look at
different solution concepts, based on different postulates,
because they illuminate the problem from different angles. In this spirit, the least core offers a complementary perspective
to the Shapley value by emphasizing coalitional stability

blocks.en: B.4.5 Scope of the comparison
blocks.zh: 第B.4.5条 比较的范围

blocks.en:
The natural contextual-distractor cohort is selected using human annotations,
independent localization, and a context-dependent sign-reversal criterion.
The reported attribution results therefore characterize this selected
population rather than ImageNet images in general.
Furthermore, because the contextual-distractor and random-SAM cohorts are
constructed using different selection criteria, their comparison should be
interpreted as an empirical comparison between the resulting cohorts rather
than as a causal effect of sign reversal alone.
